title: The Broken Road trilogy
description: Read The Broken Road in order: The Wall that Lied, No Wall to Hold and What We Save.
intro: Amazon identifies The Broken Road as a three-book sequence. The Wall that Lied introduces engineer Tomas Parker and Auster; No Wall to Hold continues along the roads beyond the city; What We Save concludes the trilogy. The Kindle editions were still preorder listings at the 23 September 2026 review.

title: Jason Proud and the ToKnight books
description: Start Jason Proud's middle-grade fantasy story with ToKnight, then continue with ToKnight 2: The Fire Beneath.
intro: Jason Proud's fantasy story begins in ToKnight and continues in ToKnight 2: The Fire Beneath. The second book's author page explicitly identifies it as the second Jason Proud book.

title: Free to a Good Home and A Place of His Own
description: Read Free to a Good Home, then the later story A Place of His Own.
intro: The author describes A Place of His Own as a sequel to Free to a Good Home. These two books follow related characters at different points in their lives; the current public sources do not establish a formal series name.
